review.notes: Cost structure is identical in both scripts (`s.cost` releases via `Duel.SelectReleaseGroupCost` as a cost, with the same `s.costfilter`), and neither script sets EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET, so no targeting change is involved. The goat operation's restructured if/else around `Duel.SpecialSummon` exists only to reach the else-branch; the success path is unchanged, `aux.NecroValleyFilter` is applied in both. Text lineage v0 (ROD-EN002, 2004-06-29) -> v1 (LCYW-EN072, 2012-09-29) is PSCT rewording only ("Activate this card by offering 1 face-up \"Dark Magician\" on your side of the field as a Tribute." -> "Tribute 1 face-up \"Dark Magician\";"), hence modern_text_version null. Verification-half bounds: old attested through 2011-02-02, modern from 2019-04-03.

event.historical_text: Activate this card by offering 1 face-up "Dark Magician" on your side of the field as a Tribute. Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician Knight" from your hand, Deck or Graveyard.
event.summary: Period ruling package. Activation condition: the modern `s.target` requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_GRAVE,...)`, while the goat target returns true, so the card can be activated - and the cost of Tributing your face-up "Dark Magician" paid - with no "Dark Magician Knight" anywhere, losing the Dark Magician for nothing. Failed-search verification: on a whiff the goat operation calls `Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)`, revealing hand and Deck but not the Graveyard, which is already public. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so the change stays unresolved.
